lines.en: I push the cottage door open and step out
My robe drags over the threshold

lines.zh: 我手里的瓶子晃着，药水很满
lines.en: The bottle in my hand sloshes, full to the neck
I walk step by step into the mud
My hat sits crooked and I don't fix it

lines.zh: 我在大锅旁边绕了一圈
lines.en: I circle the cauldron once
My steps seem to measure something
I go to the window and come back

lines.zh: 我的手指沾着一点绿色
lines.en: There's a trace of green on my fingers

lines.zh: 我背上的翅膀扇了一下
lines.en: The wings on my back beat once
I cross a ring of mushrooms
I stop at the door and look back
Grass seeds cling to my hem
I murmur as I walk
I go around a well

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上比我矮
lines.en: My shadow on the wall is shorter than I am
I stand, a bottle in my fingers
The fire under the pot still bubbles
Under my hat, my eyes don't move

lines.zh: 瓶里的光晃了一下，又灭了。
lines.en: The light in the bottle wavers and goes out.

lines.zh: 翅膀在袍子下面轻轻开合
lines.en: Under the robe, the wings open and close
There's no smile on my face
The house smells of potions
I drop a herb into the pot
I count the bottles on the shelf
The fog outside hasn't lifted
Even my breathing stays light
I'm waiting for the brew
You're standing in my yard
I move the bottle to my other hand
You didn't knock at my door
My brim dips a little

lines.zh: 你要买什么，还是要什么
lines.en: Are you buying, or taking
The thing on my back is looking at you
Stay away from the pot
I don't often ask people in
Keep your hands off the shelf

lines.zh: 你踩到了我院里的草药。
lines.en: You stepped on the herbs in my yard.
I step back and catch the door
I bite my lip and make no sound
A new tear in my robe

lines.zh: 我按住伤处，手指是绿的
lines.en: I press the wound and my fingers come away green
The wings tremble under my robe
I brace on the shelf
I pick up my hat and put it back on
I stare at you and my eyes go darker
I retreat slowly to the pot
I haven't lost yet
That herb in your hand is good
Put it on the table; don't hand it to me
This will make a pot
That herb in your hand is decent.
Open the bottle and smell it
I know this smell well

lines.zh: 我的手伸出去又缩回来
lines.en: My hand goes out and comes back
Don't shake it; it'll spill
That's enough; thank you
You smell of flowers

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，瓶子差点掉
lines.en: You bump me and the bottle nearly falls

lines.zh: 我退了一步，袍子缠住脚
lines.en: I step back and my robe catches my feet
I brace a hand on the frame

lines.zh: 你擦着我的袍角挤过去
lines.en: You squeeze past brushing my hem
My hat gets knocked off
The wings beat wild under the robe
I push you off, gently

lines.zh: 我们撞到架子，瓶子响了
lines.en: We hit the shelf and the bottles ring
I crouch to pick up my hat
You back into the yard

lines.zh: 雾里走出另一个戴帽子的
lines.en: Another hat comes out of the fog
We exchange a bottle
Her wings are bigger than mine
We stand by the cauldron

lines.zh: 她的帽子下也没有表情
lines.en: There's no expression under her hat either
We each murmur our own words
The fire flares once
She shares a herb with me

lines.zh: 我们一起看着锅里的泡
lines.en: We watch the bubbles together
Two of us brew tonight
I pinch it up to the light
I don't recognize this
I drop it into the pot
The color in the pot changes
The bitterness of this thing stings my nose.
I tuck it into my robe
It crumbles between my fingers
I'll keep this one

lines.zh: 我把它放到架上最里面
lines.en: I put it at the back of the shelf
Best not ask what this is
You touched what you shouldn't
I set the bottle down
I raise a hand, my sleeve wide
The yard has only one way out
The thing on my back has woken
It darkens under my brim
You've backed to the well
I don't shout; shouting is useless
That pot was brewed for nothing

lines.zh: 你站的地方是我撒过药的
lines.en: You're standing where I scattered powder
I reach into my sleeve
Fog presses in from the wall

lines.zh: 我在你脚边撒了点东西
lines.en: I've scattered something at your feet
You cough once, lightly
You go left; the fog is thicker there
No hurry; the brew needs time
You're at the well's rim; mind the drop
You hear the pot rattling
You're not standing well
A little longer still

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西泼出去
lines.en: I fling what's in my hand

lines.zh: 这一下打在你的手臂上
lines.en: This lands on your arm
The bottle breaks; the smell stings
I catch your face with the back of my hand
You pull back with smoke on your sleeve
I bring my foot down

lines.zh: 这一下偏了，地上烧出一圈
lines.en: I miss and the ground burns in a ring
My hand closes on your collar

lines.zh: 你被推得后退，撞翻了架子
lines.en: You're shoved back into the shelf
Every bottle on the shelf shattered
A hat appears in the fog first
I come from inside to the doorway

lines.zh: 锅底的火忽然亮了一下
lines.en: The fire under the pot flares once

lines.zh: 院子里的花全朝我转过来
lines.en: Every flower in the yard turns to me

lines.zh: 我手里的瓶子还在冒气
lines.en: The bottle in my hand still fumes

lines.zh: 我站在门口，没有请你进
lines.en: I stand in the doorway and don't invite you in

lines.zh: 雾把我的一半藏起来了
lines.en: The fog hides half of me

lines.zh: 我的脚步在木地板上响
lines.en: My steps sound on the boards
It's quiet enough to hear the brew bubble
I raise a hand and lower my hat

lines.zh: 火烧到我的袍角，我拍了两下
lines.en: Fire takes my hem and I slap at it

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上摔下去，帽子滚开
lines.en: I fall down the steps and my hat rolls off

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喉咙，药味也没了
lines.en: Water fills my throat and the potion taste is gone
The blast wrecks half the room

lines.zh: 这具身体，已经不听我的。
lines.en: This body no longer obeys me.
Magic binds my wings

lines.zh: 我熬了三天药，没吃东西
lines.en: Three days of brewing and no food

lines.zh: 雷打进屋里，我的瓶子全碎了
lines.en: Lightning enters the house and every bottle breaks

lines.zh: 脚下没有地板，药锅也没了
lines.en: No floor below, and the cauldron is gone too
